note: P3714 (Pro 1:23) — Wisdom's promise to those who turn: pour out her spirit, make her words known. ruach = the inner life Wisdom imparts; yada(Hi) = the making-known.

dims.v: spirit — the inner life/mind Wisdom pours out on those who turn to her
Wisdom (who pours it), given to the responsive
pouring out her spirit — the self-giving of Wisdom's inner life to the one who turns at reproof
welded to making-her-words-known — spirit and word given together
ruach here is Wisdom's self imparted, conditioned on 'if you turn' — the inner life is not seized but poured on the responsive. Personified-Wisdom's spirit, offered to the human interior.
to make known — Wisdom causing her words to be known to the responsive
making her words known — the act of imparting knowledge to the one who turns
paired with the outpoured spirit — the two gifts to the responsive
the Hiphil of yada (make-known) is the counter-movement to the fool's hating-knowledge (1:22): Wisdom actively GIVES the very knowledge the fool refuses.
